provenance.citation: Field et al. (2014), USGS Open-File Report 2013-1165 / BSSA 104(3); UCERF3 branch-averaged fault-system solutions
provenance.format: grid_sources.bin double-array-list (x bins shared, then unassoc/subseismo y arrays per node) + relm_gridded_region.csv node positions

mfdDef.note: incremental annual rates at 0.1-mag bin centers 5.05..8.95; bins with rate<=1e-7 and bins fully below M5.0 dropped (never touch RP<=10k hazard); rates rounded to 4 significant digits (relative 1e-4, nil against GMPE sigma); u=unassociated (off-fault), s=sub-seismogenic (on-fault small-M) per UCERF3 semantics
